production_policy: No registered model is production-eligible until it has local field validation, approved governance, model monitoring, and a deployment review.

models.purpose: Pipeline benchmark only; not a field theft-detection model.
limitations: Theft classes are synthetic transformations, not verified theft incidents.
The random benchmark split may not represent future, unseen customers or a Nigerian DisCo distribution network.
Do not use this model for enforcement, customer action, or production alerting.
A local field-labelled dataset and topology-aware energy balance evidence are required for a production revenue-protection model.

models.display_name: UCI per-client Isolation Forest anomaly benchmark
models.purpose: Unsupervised consumption anomaly benchmark only; not theft detection.
limitations: UCI records are not Nigerian DisCo data and include no verified theft labels.
The model is fitted retrospectively over each client's full history; it is not a prospective field evaluation.
An anomaly is an investigation signal, never proof of theft.

models.purpose: Chronological decision-support benchmark only; not outage control or restoration authority.
limitations: The public source has no feeder, asset, crew, weather, switching, or documented timezone data.
Some records have no listed fault cause, so the benchmark represents them with no active cause indicator.
The MTTR category is derived from historical restoration outcome and does not establish causality.
Predictions may support investigation and resource planning only; authorised personnel and protection procedures govern restoration decisions.
